description: This file defines the UserPrincipal class, which implements the Spring Security UserDetails interface. It adapts a User entity and associated authorization groups into a security context compatible object, providing user credentials and authorities information.

classes.name: UserPrincipal
classes.description: A security principal implementation for representing authenticated users within Spring Security context.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Returns the authorities granted to the user, derived from auth groups.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password of the user.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username of the user.

methods.name: isAccountNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the user's account has expired.

methods.name: isAccountNonLocked
methods.description: Indicates whether the user's account is locked.

methods.name: isCredentialsNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the user's credentials have expired.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the user is enabled.
